WITH rollup_totals AS (
    -- Join a dimension and aggregate
    SELECT
        d.job_title AS employee_job_title,
        s.job_title AS employee_job_title,
        COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
        MAX(s.salary) AS max_salary,
        GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level
    FROM employees s
    INNER JOIN employees d ON s.manager_id = d.id
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.job_title, s.job_title), (d.job_title), ())
)
SELECT
    employee_job_title,
    employee_job_title,
    rows_total,
    max_salary,
    grouping_level,
    CASE WHEN employee_job_title RLIKE '^(Analyst|Manager)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN employee_job_title RLIKE '^(Engineer|Director)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS employee_job_title_zone
FROM rollup_totals
ORDER BY employee_job_title, max_salary;

    select
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        cost,
        status,
        dense_rank() over (partition by status order by cost asc) as cost_dense_rank,
        first_value(carrier) ignore nulls over (partition by carrier, order_id order by cost asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_carrier,
        avg(cost) over (partition by month(delivered_date), carrier order by cost asc, id asc rows between 3 preceding and 1 preceding) as cost_avg_3_prior
    from shipments
),
joined as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select s.*, d.status as order_status
    from metrics s
    left join orders d
        on s.order_id = d.id
    where d.amount >= 1070
),
with_dims as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select
        src.*,
        o.status as order_status_2,
        o.discount,
        o.shipping_fee
    from joined src
    left join orders o
        on src.order_id = o.id
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select status
    from with_dims
    except distinct
    select status
    from shipments
    where month(delivered_date) in (5, 6, 7)
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from with_dims s
    join remaining_keys k on s.status = k.status
)

    p.status as order_status,
    a.order_status_2,
    count(*) as cnt,
    round(avg(a.cost_avg_3_prior), 2) as avg_cost_avg_3_prior,
    grouping_id() as gid
from verified a

    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        email,
        job_title,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        round(salary * 0.85, 2) as adjusted_salary,
        coalesce(level, 'UNKNOWN') as level_clean
    from employees
    where hire_date >= to_date('2023-03-22')
      and dept_id in (3, 15, 35)
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        job_title,
        level_clean,
        avg(adjusted_salary) over (partition by job_title order by adjusted_salary, id rows between 5 preceding and current row) as adjusted_salary_avg_5,
        ntile(4) over (partition by job_title order by adjusted_salary desc, id) as adjusted_salary_bucket,
        sum(adjusted_salary) over w_running as running_adjusted_salary,
        avg(adjusted_salary) over (partition by job_title order by hire_date, id rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding) as adjusted_salary_avg_2_prior
    from valid
    window w_running as (partition by job_title order by adjusted_salary, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
valid_employees as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        *,
        case when adjusted_salary_bucket >= 7 then 'High' when adjusted_salary_bucket >= 2 then 'Medium' else 'Low' end as adjusted_salary_bucket_tier,
        adjusted_salary_bucket * adjusted_salary_avg_5 as adjusted_salary_bucket_times_adjusted_salary_avg_5
    from metrics
    where job_title is not null
),
deduped as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *
    from (
        select *, rank() over (partition by job_title order by running_adjusted_salary desc nulls last) as latest_rank
        from valid_employees
    ) x
    where latest_rank = 1
),

    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select
        id,
        adjusted_salary_bucket,
        adjusted_salary_avg_2_prior,
        adjusted_salary_bucket_tier,
        adjusted_salary_bucket_times_adjusted_salary_avg_5
    from deduped
    qualify row_number() over (partition by job_title order by adjusted_salary_avg_5 nulls last, id) = 1

    from deduped
    intersect

    where channel is null

reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation

    from deduped s
    join remaining_keys k on s.promo_code = k.promo_code
),
